w:r.w:t: Using icons in a BwB report
Where icons help, and how to place them in the approved colours
An icon earns its place when it names a topic, marks a callout or labels a tile. Inline icons sit with the text, for example
institutions, and take the size of the line.
Use few icons, and give every one a job. A page of icons is decoration, not signposting.
Lime and white never go on a light background. The builder substitutes an approved colour and says so.
